elongated-cable-7in.title: Elongated Cable Chain Bracelet, 7 Inch, 3mm Links, 10K Solid Gold
elongated-cable-7in.description:
A 3 mm chain of long rounded links in solid 10K gold, made in a 7 inch length.

Each link is stretched to about twice its width, so the chain shows more air than metal. Modern, but not loud.

Metal: solid 10K gold.
Finish: solid gold, no plating, no stones.
Size: 3 mm elongated cable links.
Length: 7 inches, with a lobster clasp.

Each piece is made to order and ships from New Jersey. Add a gift message at checkout and it ships with the piece.

Care: solid gold does not tarnish. Wipe it with a soft cloth.

The handmade piece may vary slightly.
